reportedProblems: Restricted project profile disabled repository write grants in the browser.
Codegraph rendered nested SDK statistics as React children (error 31), and a valid empty graph returned a missing-node error.
Native provider subscription login was not discoverable or clearly distinguished from HAPI runner access.

confirmedReviewFindings.finding: A repeated same-profile PUT after remount/lost response revoked newly issued runner leases.
confirmedReviewFindings.resolution: Authorization and current-profile comparison now occur inside the same immediate SQLite transaction; same target is a no-op without audit/revocation. Actual API/lease/capability tests cover retries, roles and a real subsequent profile change.

confirmedReviewFindings.finding: An index revision replaced the graph query and lost canvas zoom/pan.
confirmedReviewFindings.resolution: Retain prior data only for the same principal/project/role and selection while changing index version. Regression keeps the same canvas and transform.

confirmedReviewFindings.finding: Provider operator documentation used the wrong egress variable.
confirmedReviewFindings.resolution: Use EVOLVED_EGRESS_HOSTS and explain that it replaces the Compose default host list.

otherCorrections: Lost GitHub mutation responses reconcile with a server GET.
Existing browser failure states are not presented as empty Codegraph results; revoked access hides cached graph data.
Provider instructions are reachable before creating a project.
Active profile buttons cannot send another profile change.
Codegraph status exposes only three scalar counts; UI also tolerates nested legacy SDK stats.

validation.browserCodegraph: Actual authenticated browser/Hub/adapter/SDK with synthetic workspace; empty -> automatic indexing -> graph/source/reindex.
validation.browserGithub: Actual browser/Hub/signed Vault broker with synthetic GitHub provider; restricted new/edit write grants, no implicit profile escalation, explicit profile activation, old lease revoked/new lease default scope, account isolation, rotation/revocation.
validation.providerAuthentication: Installed CLI help and official documentation checked; no real provider login performed.

limits: No real GitHub token or subscriber login was used; no actual remote Git push tested.
Subscription page documents native runner CLI login; it does not implement browser OAuth or claim verified provider status.
Responsive Chromium acceptance only; no physical Safari/iOS test.
Operator browser was not accessed; Codegraph defect was reproduced independently with the actual SDK data contract.
postReviewChanges: Explicit TypeScript query result parameters corrected inference for placeholderData without changing runtime behavior.
Background-refresh test mock returns a valid status shape to prevent timing-dependent failures.
Real browser fixture supplies its generated synthetic service token through the required private file; no production credentials read.
